name: Can any interior wall be removed during a home layout change?

mainEntity.name: Can any interior wall be removed during a home layout change?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ability to remove an interior wall depends on whether it is load-bearing or non-load-bearing. Non-load-bearing partition walls can usually be removed with minimal structural disruption, though electrical or plumbing lines inside them still need relocation. Load-bearing walls support the weight of the roof or upper floors and cannot be removed without installing an engineered support beam, such as a steel or laminated veneer lumber (LVL) beam, supported by posts and reinforced footings. A licensed general contractor works with a structural engineer to inspect your home framing and calculate the required beam dimensions before taking down any wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, walls cannot all be removed freely. Non-load-bearing walls come down easily, but load-bearing walls require engineered support beams and posts to safely carry structural weight.
